tagline: Hands-on gadget reviews: a blue italic title over the device you hold, a whip into a close-up of it in your hand, small clean captions and a red counter that ticks up.
needs: you talking with the device in hand + close-up clips of the device in your hand (a second camera or phone)
readiness_note: Shoot close-ups of the device in your hand (checklist included); without them the reel falls back to screen recordings in a drawn phone.

captions: Hook: the device held up, a punch-in zoom on the device, the blue italic title pops in phrase by phrase, then the zoom-flash whip
Count-up: hand-held close-up of the device with the red counter ticking above one white caption line
End card: black wordmark card with the comment keyword
